exposure: cerebroplacental ratio (CPR) multiples of the median (MoM)
vertebroplacental ratio (VPR) multiples of the median (MoM)
cohort: 1470 pregnancies undergoing an ultrasound assessment of umbilical artery, middle cerebral artery, and vertebral artery Doppler beyond 34 weeks' gestation within 14 days of delivery.
finding: All studied fetal Doppler parameters (CPR and VPR) were poorly associated with neonatal acid-base status, though VPR was found to be a valid alternative to CPR in the evaluation of fetal wellbeing.
